newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Sept retail trade sales fall 2.3 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: S.African Sept retail trade sales fall 2.3 pct m/m.

text.p: South African retail trade sales fell a seasonally adjusted 2.3 percent month-on-month in September to 11.24 billion rand at current prices, latest Central Statistical Service (CSS) data shows.
Year-on-year, seasonally adjusted retail sales were up 7.3 percent from 10.48 billion rand in September 1995, the CSS said.
On an actual basis, retail trade sales were up 1.9 percent month-on-month and up 7.3 percent year-on-year.
